title: mojo-rs harness events
description: JSONL event stream produced by executing a casefile against one implementation (oracle driver or candidate harness). One JSON object per line. The shape matches the oracle driver's emission exactly (base::JSONWriter, lexicographically sorted keys): trap events carry the trigger result in the top-level `result`, the trigger context in `trigger_context`, and the signal state in `signals_state`.

result.description: MOJO_RESULT_* name; for trap events this is the trigger event's result (OK when satisfied, FAILED_PRECONDITION when unsatisfiable, CANCELLED on removal/closure)

handle.description: symbolic handle token from the casefile

trigger_context.description: the trigger context for trap events

signals_state.description: signal state at a trap event

process.description: process name for multi-process cases (parent or peer name)
